prompt: Rendered in the style of an oil painting, the scene unfolds within a sterile hospital corridor where thick brushstrokes capture the tension of a busy morning. On the far left, a man in a red scarf stands rigidly, holding a crumpled tissue in his trembling hand while looking at a woman in a blue coat who sits on a hard plastic chair nearby. Next to her, a small child in yellow pajamas clutches a teddy bear, resting their head against the woman's knee. A brown dog on a leash stands patiently beside the child, its ears perked up as it looks at a nurse in white scrubs walking past. The nurse in white scrubs is pointing at a clipboard held by a doctor in a grey suit standing in the center of the hallway. The doctor in a grey suit is handing a pen to an elderly man with a cane who leans heavily against the wall. Next to the elderly man, a young intern in green scrubs is looking at a digital tablet, ignoring the chaos around them. A wheelchair sits empty near the intern, its chrome wheels reflecting the overhead lights. Above the wheelchair, a ceiling light flickers slightly, casting long shadows. To the right, a security guard in a dark uniform stands with arms crossed, watching a delivery person in an orange vest who is handing a large cardboard box to a receptionist behind a high counter. The receptionist behind the high counter is typing on a keyboard, glancing briefly at the delivery person. A potted fern sits on the counter next to the receptionist, its leaves drooping slightly. Behind the fern, a stack of medical files teeters precariously. A janitor with a mop bucket pushes through the crowd from the background, navigating around a stretcher that blocks part of the path. The stretcher has a thin mattress and metal rails. A patient under a white sheet lies still on the stretcher, only their feet visible. An IV bag hangs from the stretcher pole, dripping slowly. There is no sunlight streaming through windows. There is no digital clock on the wall. There is no blood on the floor.
